results.title: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk shares remain suspended amid acquisition plans
results.body: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk, whose shares have been suspended by Bursa Efek Indonesia, faced a latest suspension on 31 August 2026 after an earlier suspension on 26 August 2026 that was lifted on 27 August 2026. Management confirmed the company intends to pursue both organic growth and acquisitions of complementary businesses while urging the public not to disclose information ahead of any rights issue. The stock had risen roughly 107% over the preceding month, a surge linked to speculation about the large‑scale fundraising and acquisition activity.

results.title: Indonesia Stock Exchange suspends trading of PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk and PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk
results.body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange announced a temporary suspension of trading for PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk and PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk. The suspension, effective from the pre-opening session on 7 September 2026 in both the regular and cash markets, was prompted by sharp cumulative price gains, with PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk's shares up 58% over the past week and nearly 100% in the past month, and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk's shares up 32% in the past week and 132% in the past month. BEI said the measure is intended to protect investors by giving market participants sufficient time to assess information before making investment decisions.

results.title: BEI suspends trading of PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk
results.body: BEI announced the temporary suspension of trading for PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, effective from the opening of the first session on Monday, 7 September 2026. The suspension was applied as a cooling‑down measure to protect investors after both stocks experienced sharp consecutive gains that triggered the Auto Reject Top (ARA) limit—Olympus rose 25% to Rp975 on 2 September and 24.63% to Rp1,265 on 4 September, while Prima Globalindo logged eight consecutive days hitting the Auto Reject Top, climbing from Rp224 on 22 August to Rp468 on 4 September. Olympus faces its first suspension, potentially lasting one trading day, whereas Prima Globalindo is under its second suspension, the first having occurred on 2 September. Both shares were halted on the Regular and Cash Markets pending further announcement from the exchange.

results.title: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk shares over abnormal price surges
results.body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia temporarily suspended trading of two securities on Monday, 7 September 2026. The halted shares are PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, suspended due to unusually rapid price increases. PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk rose 93.1% in the past month and 300.3% year‑to‑date, while PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk surged 131.6% in a month and 154.3% year‑to‑date. The exchange said the cooling‑down measure aims to protect investors, as explained by Yulianto Aji Sadono, Head of the Transaction Supervision Division.

results.title: PT Wijaya Karya Gedung Tbk (WEGE) Wins New RSU Ulin Hospital Renovation Contract Valued at Rp 121.98 Billion
results.body: PT Wijaya Karya Gedung Tbk (WEGE) signed a contract on 4 September 2026 to renovate the operating rooms of RSU Ulin in Banjarmasin, South Kalimantan, valued at Rp 121,987 billion, to be executed under a design-and-build scheme through a joint operation (KSO) with PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk and targeted for completion by 30 December 2026. WEGE reported that its new contract portfolio reached Rp 775 billion as of August 2026—a 568% increase from the prior year—with project owners comprising 83% government entities and 17% state-owned enterprises (BUMN), and funding for the RSU Ulin project sourced from the South Kalimantan provincial budget (APBD).

results.title: BUVA Approaches Rp1.53 Trillion Rights Issue to Fund Uluwatu Expansion and Debt Repayment
results.body: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk (BUVA) is moving closer to a Rp1.53 trillion rights issue, issuing 6.15 billion new shares at an exercise price of Rp250 per share, with the registration statement expected effective on September 16, 2026. The proceeds will primarily fund Uluwatu premium area expansion through its subsidiary PT Bukit Bali Permai, which will acquire PT Royal Uluwatu Residence and develop 3.9 hectares of land, alongside infrastructure for Uluwatu Estate targeted for completion by Q4 2028. Controlling shareholder PT Nusantara Utama Investama (NUI), holding 61.07%, plans to exercise 2.4 billion rights, while standby buyers including Henan Putihrai Sekuritas, PT Tata Tirta Datun, Happy Hapsoro, and Ferry Sudjono have committed up to Rp938.57 billion. Additional allocations include Rp417.8 billion for accelerated debt repayment and Rp300 billion for renovations at Alila Ubud and Lagoi Bintan infrastructure.

results.title: BEI Suspends Trading of PT Charnic Capital Tbk, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk
results.body: On 4 September 2026, BEI temporarily halted trading of PT Charnic Capital Tbk, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk after their share prices surged by hundreds of percent, prompting a cooling‑down measure to protect investors. The suspension, effective from session I in both the Regular and Cash Markets, will remain in force until further notice, as stated by Endra Febri Styawan, Acting Head of Transaction Supervision Division at BEI.

results.title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk, PT Charnic Capital Tbk, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk and PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspended trading of four listed companies at the start of the first trading session on Friday, 4 September 2026. The suspended stocks are PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk, PT Charnic Capital Tbk, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk and PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk. In the past month, PT Charnic Capital Tbk rose 100%, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk rose 91.8% but fell 27.6% year‑to‑date, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk surged 119.4% and up 66.3% year‑to‑date, and PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk jumped 99% and up 100.9% year‑to‑date, prompting the exchange to act. The exchange said the suspensions aim to cool down abnormal price movements and protect investors by giving them time to consider decisions based on available information.

results.title: Nicholas Santoso Buys Shares of Charnic Capital
results.body: Nicholas Santoso, an insider of Charnic Capital (NICK.JK), purchased an additional 108,200 shares on 2 September 2026 at an average price of about IDR 1,880 per share, costing IDR 203,379,000. The transaction raised his holding to 291,600 shares, representing 0.04% of the company's outstanding shares, up from 0.03%. This purchase continues a pattern of accumulation observed since August, when he bought 68,700 shares at roughly IDR 1,551 and 15,700 shares at about IDR 1,887, reflecting an ongoing investment strategy.

results.title: Session I: IHSG surges in green zone, buoyed by optimism from Trump’s remarks on Iran
results.body: The article reports that during Session I on Thursday 3 September 2026 the Indonesia Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 6,663, up 1.03%, keeping the market in a green zone and lifting the LQ45 index 1.35% to 660.66. The rally was led by transport, industrial and energy sectors and by top gainers PT Griptha Putra Persada Tbk (+25%), PT Guna Timur Raya Tbk (+25%) and PT Pakuan Tbk (+24.9%), with optimism after President Donald Trump’s brief‑Iran attack comment also driving oil prices down to $89.92 per barrel for WTI and $94.29 for Brent and supporting modest gains across Asian indices.

results.title: BEI lifts suspensions on four stocks: PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk, PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk, PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk
results.body: On Thursday, 3 September 2026, the Indonesia Stock Exchange lifted the temporary suspensions on the shares of four listed issuers. The affected issuers are PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk, PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk, and PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk, whose shares had been halted due to sharp price spikes. Prior to the lift, PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk’s shares rose 84.7% in the past month and 110.8% year‑to‑date, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk’s shares rose 99.1% month‑over‑month and 50.9% YTD, PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk’s shares surged 167% in the month and 1,151% YTD, and PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk’s shares climbed 187.3% in the month and 666.9% YTD. BEI said the suspensions, imposed on 2 September for PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk and PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk, on 24 August for PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk, and on 19 August for PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk, were a cooling‑down measure to protect investors, and the lifting now permits trading in both the regular and cash markets.

results.title: BEI Lifts Suspension on PPGL, ALKA, LIFE, and AGAR Shares, Trading Resumes Thursday (Sept 3)
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) announced on Wednesday (Sept 2, 2026) that it will lift the trading suspension on four stocks effective Thursday (Sept 3, 2026). The affected companies are PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk (PPGL), PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk (ALKA), PT Asia Sejahtera Mina Tbk (AGAR), and PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk (LIFE). PPGL had been suspended since Sept 2 after rising 43.7% in five days to Rp 388 per share and 94% over one month. ALKA was suspended on Aug 24 after surging 429.48% in a month to Rp 4,580, and will resume in the Session I Periodic Call Auction. AGAR faced two suspension periods: first from Aug 19 after a 258.41% monthly gain to Rp 1,810, and again from Sept 2 after a 99.14% monthly rise to Rp 11,550.

results.title: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk shares jump 75% in eight days, hit auto rejection top for six sessions and face two suspensions as 15 brokers post net buying.
results.body: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk shares surged 75% from Rp320 to Rp560 over eight trading days through August 31, 2026, triggering auto rejection top (ARA) for six consecutive sessions and two temporary trading suspensions by the Indonesia Stock Exchange. During the period, 15 brokers recorded net buying, led by PT CGS International with Rp47.2 billion, followed by PT Samuel Sekuritas (Rp27.3 billion) and Sucor Sekuritas (Rp21.9 billion). The stock's major shareholders above 1% collectively control 75.83% of shares, with PT Eco Energi Perkasa holding 40.57%, Haji Isam (Andi Samsuddin Arsyad) 21.12%, Providentia Wealth Management Ltd 5.41%, DBS 3.94%, UOB Kay Hian Pte Ltd 2.47%, Haristo 1.16%, and PO Susanto 1.16%. Free float stands at 38.17%.

results.title: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk (PACK) suspended after 75% surge and six consecutive auto reject top sessions
results.body: Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) suspended trading in PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk (PACK) on 1 September 2026 after the stock surged 75% over eight trading sessions from Rp320 on 20 August to Rp560 on 31 August, hitting the auto reject top (ARA) limit for six consecutive trading days. BEI had previously halted trading on 27 August, reopened it on 28 August, and reimposed suspension on 1 September, citing significant cumulative price increases and investor protection. The suspension applies to both the Regular and Cash markets until further notice. Andi Syamsuddin Arsyad (Haji Isam) holds a direct 21.11% stake in PACK as of July 2026, while PT Eco Energi Perkasa controls 40.56%.

results.title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Steady Safe Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia temporarily suspended trading of PT Steady Safe Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk on the regular and cash markets, effective from the first session on 2 September 2026, due to a significant cumulative price increase. The suspension, described as a cooling‑down measure, aims to give investors time to consider decisions based on available information until further notice.

results.title: BEI suspends PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Steady Safe Tbk after Auto Reject Top (ARA) hit Rp875
results.body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) temporarily halted trading of PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Steady Safe Tbk starting in session I on Tuesday, 2 September 2026. The suspension was announced by Endra Febri Styawan, Acting Head of the BEI Transaction Supervision Division, as a cooling‑down measure following a significant cumulative price increase that triggered an Auto Reject Top (ARA) at 25 % to Rp 875. SAFE faces a second suspension that could keep its shares locked for more than a day and possibly up to a week, while LIFE and PPGL are likely to be suspended for a single trading day each. PPGL had risen for six consecutive days since 24 August, highlighting the rapid price movement that prompted the exchange’s action.

results.title: Nicholas Santoso Buys Shares of Charnic Capital
results.body: Nicholas Santoso, an insider of Charnic Capital (NICK.JK), purchased an additional 15,700 shares on 1 September 2026 at an average price of approximately IDR 1,886.6 per share, costing IDR 29,619,500. The buy raises his holding to 182,900 shares, still representing about 0.03% of the company's issued capital. This transaction follows a series of purchases since August, where Santoso accumulated roughly 100,000 shares, moving his ownership from 0.01% to the current 0.03%, indicating ongoing personal investment in the firm.

results.title: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia Suspends PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk, and PT Steady Safe Tbk Over Sharp Price Gains
results.body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia temporarily suspended trading of three stocks—PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk and PT Steady Safe Tbk—starting in the first session on Wednesday, 2 September 2026. The suspension was imposed because the shares experienced unusually rapid price increases, with PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk rising 84.7% over the past month and 110.8% year‑to‑date, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk gaining 99.1% over the month and 50.9% year‑to‑date, and PT Steady Safe Tbk climbing 136.4% over the month and 118.7% year‑to‑date. Yulianto Aji Sadono, head of the Transaction Monitoring Division, said the measure provides a cooling‑down period to protect investors by allowing them time to consider decisions based on available information. The exchange urged interested parties to monitor disclosures from the listed companies.

results.title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk for second time after six consecutive days hitting Auto Reject Top
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) halted trading of PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk on 1 September 2026, marking the second suspension after an initial halt on 27 August 2026. The suspension applies to both the Regular Market and the Cash Market and will remain in effect until further notice. BEI cited investor protection after the stock hit the Auto Reject Top (ARA) for six straight days, during which its price rose from Rp320 on 20 August to Rp560 on 31 August, a 75% increase in one week. PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk is identified in the article as the "black horse" stock owned by Andi Syamsudin Arsyad (Isam).

results.title: Nicholas Santoso Buys Shares of Charnic Capital
results.body: Nicholas Santoso purchased an additional 700 shares of Charnic Capital at an average price of IDR 1,905 per share, totaling IDR 1,333,500, on August 31, 2026. The purchase raises his holding to 167,200 shares, representing 0.030% of the company's equity, unchanged from before the transaction. This buy adds to a series of acquisitions over the past six months, during which Santoso accumulated roughly 86,000 shares, moving his stake from 0.010% to the current 0.030% and indicating a continued investment in the firm.

results.title: BEI Suspends PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk Stock After 294% YTD Surge
results.body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) temporarily suspended trading of PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk (PACK) because its share price rose abnormally. Stockbit data showed the stock gained 147.7% in the past month and 294.3% year‑to‑date, prompting the suspension at the start of session I on 1 September 2026. BEI said the measure is a cooling‑down action to protect investors, as explained by Yulianto Aji Sadono.

results.title: Top Gainers on the IDX on 31 August 2026 led by PT DMS Propertindo Tbk soaring 34.16% after announcing a rights issue
results.body: PT DMS Propertindo Tbk jumped 34.16% to 216 on 31 August 2026 after disclosing a rights issue of 100 billion new shares at Rp25 each, aiming to raise Rp4.4 trillion for land‑asset acquisitions. Other notable gainers included PT Indo Acidatama Tbk up 31.8% to Rp97, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk up 25% to Rp310, Bank Sinarmas Tbk up 24.82% to Rp880, PT Fortune Indonesia Tbk up 24.62% to Rp2,480, PT Kedaung Indah Can Tbk up 24.37% to Rp296, PT Logindo Samudramakmur Tbk up 18% to Rp118, PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk up 17.46% to Rp9,925, PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk up 16.79% to Rp800, and PT Indo Oil Perkasa Tbk up 15.93% to Rp262. The IDX Composite closed up 0.11% at 6,525.47, with 413 advancing, 245 declining and 305 unchanged stocks and a total market capitalization of Rp11,448.27 trillion. PT DMS Propertindo Tbk is identified in the article as the issuer (emiten) of the rights issue, while the other companies are listed solely as stocks that recorded price gains.

results.title: PT Steady Safe Tbk shares suspended by BEI after 86% price surge
results.body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) suspended trading of PT Steady Safe Tbk (SAFE) shares at the start of the first session on Monday 31 August 2026. The suspension follows an abnormal cumulative price increase, with the stock rising 86.1% over the past month and 75% year‑to‑date. BEI described the action as a cooling‑down measure to protect investors and allow them time to consider decisions based on available information. The announcement was made by Yulianto Aji Sadono, Head of Transaction Supervision at BEI.

results.title: BEI lifts suspension on four stocks—PT Ekadharma International Tbk., PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk., PT Tempo Intimedia Tbk. and PT Bukit Darmo Property Tbk.—allowing regular trading for the first three and FCA trading for the last, with PACK reaching Auto‑Reject Atas and TMPO hitting Auto‑Reject Bottom.
results.body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) removed the trading suspension on four listed issuers on 28 August 2026. PT Ekadharma International Tbk., PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk. and PT Tempo Intimedia Tbk. resumed regular and cash‑market trading, while PT Bukit Darmo Property Tbk. resumed trading through a Periodic Call Auction (FCA). After unsuspension, PACK surged to the Auto‑Reject Atas (ARA) level of Rp510, up 44 points (+9.44%), and TMPO fell to the Auto‑Reject Bottom (ARB) level of Rp216, down 36 points (‑14.29%) at 10:24 WIB. The suspensions had been imposed the previous day due to significant price spikes, and the lift applies from session I of the regular market.

results.title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Cipta Selera Murni Tbk shares after sharp price surge
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia announced the suspension of PT Cipta Selera Murni Tbk shares on the Regular and Cash Markets starting from the pre‑opening session on 28 August 2026. The suspension was imposed as a protective measure after the stock experienced a cumulative price increase of 17.31% to Rp 183 and a 140.79% rise over the past month, even touching the Auto Reject Atas (ARA) level last week. BEI advised shareholders to closely monitor all disclosures issued by PT Cipta Selera Murni Tbk. The action reflects BEI's role in maintaining market integrity amid volatile price movements.

results.title: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Cipta Selera Murni Tbk after 140.7% monthly price surge
results.body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia suspended the shares of PT Cipta Selera Murni Tbk on Friday, 28 August 2026, citing an abnormal cumulative price increase. The stock rose 140.7% over the past month, while its year‑to‑date performance showed a 12.8% decline. The exchange described the suspension as a cooling‑down measure to protect investors. The decision was communicated by Yulianto Aji Sadono, Head of Transaction Supervision, emphasizing the need for investors to consider information carefully.

results.title: Popular news roundup highlights gold jewelry prices, a massive sell‑off in GoTo shares, PACK suspension, Cimory dividend and BBCA foreign net buying
results.body: The article presents a roundup of the five most‑read financial stories on 27 August 2026, covering jewelry gold prices and several Indonesian listed equities. Gold jewelry prices across various karats remained stable according to Raja Emas Indonesia, Hartadinata Abadi and Laku Emas. PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) faced a massive sell‑order queue of 410,228,054 lot at Rp 50 per share, exceeding Rp 2 trillion, and a total of 26 million lot traded on the BEI negotiation market at an average of Rp 24 per share, valuing Rp 63.1 billion. PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk (PACK) was suspended by the BEI after a sharp cumulative price rise, having closed at Rp 466 (+9.91%) on 26 August 2026 and gaining over 99% in the past month. PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk (CMRY) announced an interim dividend of Rp 100 per share (total Rp 793.46 billion, yield 2.15%) while its share price lingered at Rp 4,640, and PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) recorded a net foreign purchase of Rp 80.82 billion on 26 August 2026, contributing to a cumulative net buy of Rp 2.3 trillion since 12 August 2026.

results.title: Backdoor listing activity intensifies amid a weak IPO market, with several Indonesian listed firms changing control in 2025‑2026
results.body: The article discusses the growing popularity of backdoor listings in Indonesia as the Jakarta Stock Exchange’s composite index (IHSG) is down 25.4% year‑to‑date and IPO activity remains subdued. It cites recent transactions where listed companies changed controlling shareholders, including PT Platinum Wahab Nusantara Tbk (TGUK) acquired by Visionary Capital Global Pte. Ltd., PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk (KRYA) taken over by Green City SG Pte. Ltd., PT Solusi Environment Asia Tbk (SOFA) linked to Asia Investment Capital’s 70.96% purchase of PT Boston Furniture Industries Tbk, PT Futura Energi Global Tbk (FUTR) undergoing a change of control and rebranding, PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk (PACK) shifting from packaging to nickel, and PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk (VISI) bought 61.85% by Harmoni Semesta Investama for Rp178.74 billion at Rp94 per share. These deals illustrate how investors use existing “sleeping” issuers as vehicles to introduce new businesses or assets, offering a faster, more flexible route than a conventional IPO. The commentary warns that new controllers inherit legacy liabilities and that investors must scrutinize valuation, funding sources, beneficial owners, and rights‑issue purposes to avoid speculative price moves.

results.title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk shares on August 27, 2026
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) temporarily suspended trading of PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk shares on Thursday, 27 August 2026 as a cooling‑down measure. The suspension follows a significant cumulative price increase, which BEI said required protection for investors. PACK closed at Rp466 on 26 August, up 9.91% in one day, with gains of 45.63% over five days, 106.19% over one month and 154.40% year‑to‑date, while remaining 31.5% below its one‑year high of Rp680. BEI had earlier flagged the stock in an Unusual Market Activity notice on 24 August; PACK is an issuer affiliated with Haji Isam.

results.title: BEI suspends trading of PT Ekadharma International Tbk, PT Tempo Inti Media Tbk and PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk after shares rose over 100% in a month
results.body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) halted trading of the three issuers on Thursday 27 August 2026. The suspension follows sharp price gains, with PT Ekadharma International Tbk up 152.69% to Rp 422 in a month (39.74% in five days), PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk up 108.04% to Rp 466 (40.36% in five days), and PT Tempo Inti Media Tbk up 121.05% to Rp 252 (48.24% in five days). The halt applies to both the Regular Market and the Cash Market to provide a cooling‑down period and protect investors.
